notes.title: Long time, no see, also new game coming out.
notes.content:
Oh wow, I forgot about this place for a little too long. Yikes is that a spiderweb? Yeah, I'm overdue for new content.

  For those of you who come across this new announcement, I'm just here to announce a new project that will be available on steam hopefully in September unless something goes horribly wrong. The game is Mean-While and it's... you know what? I'll just link the coming soon page instead.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1339170/MeanWhile/

The game is planned to be released in september, but if you wanna try it out early, I have the entire game listed bellow on gamejolt as well. I'm not interested in posting a stripped down free version of anything so the entire game is on there. The only difference between this version and the one coming to steam will be Achievements.

https://gamejolt.com/games/meanwhile/393196

Hope you all enjoy. Also controller support should be available.

notes.title: Holiday announcement
notes.content:
Well after a month or two dinking around and finally getting my old desktop working again(seriously have no idea what was wrong with it.), I was able to get a small side project finished on my laptop for anyone looking for a new free game to try for the holidays. The new game is called Secret Santa. A simple pixel art stealth game involving Santa and landmines. Currently it's a work in progress but it's free on gamejolt for anyone wanting to take a swing at it. Also there is a shameless greenlight I posted for the game in the event people want to see this game on steam in the future with all sorts of new bells and whistles.

For anyone interested in seeing the greenlight page, you can click the link bellow here.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=575381173

Oh, and if you just want to play the game, you can click the gamejolt link here.

http://gamejolt.com/games/secret-santa/113405

As for new projects in the future. I'm probably going to invest in a new desktop soon, but during that time will be putting together a working model of an unreal 4 project soon and see where things go from there.

Till then though, Have a happy holiday.

notes.title: Finally a website, and news for anyone curious.
notes.content:
Whoa, haven't updated in awhile. Gees is that a spider? Anyway, There is now an official website for project tranquil, that I seem to have never posted or announced. It's just a website showing old projects, and will host new announcements. Bellow is the website link in all it's half hearted glory.

http://www.projecttranquil.com/

   On the subject of new projects, Irony decided to strike, and I lost a lot of the data from desktop crapping out(oh cruel irony), so during the time it will take to get things working again, I'm probably going to work on a small project for the holidays.

   Also, to hold things over, one of my friends helping me with new projects, Mr.Fishy, has just posted news of his own game titled The Away Team. A pixel art space exploration game. You can check details of it out for yourself in the link bellow.

http://www.awayteam.space


That is all for now. Hopefully a new announcement for a holiday project will be available soon.

Thank you all for your support.

--Daniel

notes.title: New update, and new project on the way.
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

   It's already been a week and almost 50 thousand people have downloaded Dev Guy. Quite remarkable actually. I'm grateful people have enjoyed it despite the valid concerns some have had.

   In response to player concerns though, an update was made for Dev Guy allowing players to skip certain minigames so they can continue without having to play through the pony game, or die constantly in “You have to up to jump”. This way players can enjoy the parts they like about dev guy and can skip the parts they have no interest in playing.

   In other news, A new Dev Guy project is already in the works. Not necessarily a sequel to Dev Guy, but definitely in the same vain. The new project will not be built in the UDK this time however, and will be also taking a very different artistic direction. More information about the new project will be posted as soon as feel comfortable releasing the news. During that time, I hope you all have enjoyed Warren's adventure, and I look forward to showing you the new project when it becomes readily presentable.


--Daniel
